_about: Hand-edited. Firms outside Russia and Belarus that a US Treasury press release names for supplying chips, microelectronics or electronic components to Russia. Each firm was checked against the cited release. Joined to OFAC's list by OFAC id; bis_name is the exact BIS Entity List name, if any.
